steps.content: The Blue Rain keeps intensifying and sears the Sinner's body, but fails to slow her down.

The single-eyed rune is burning into her, feeding her power and madness. More and more contamination-packed single-eyed Corruptors are split and replicated from Garofano's body. And farther away, strange roaring sounds came from all over the villa, this place seems to become a petri dish for Mania.

steps.speaker: Security Chief
steps.content: And they said not to kill her... How do you even do that?! Why did they make us fight a monster like this? We're only human, it's impossible...

steps.speaker: Security Chief
steps.content: FAC!! Come back! Help me! Hel...
